notes: Portal: Mopar US owner site. Per-vehicle page https://www.mopar.com/en-us/my-vehicle/owners-manual.html?year=Y&brand=Jeep&model=M (model keys from the Owners Information Sitemap https://www.mopar.com/en-us/owners-information-sitemap.html: Grand_Cherokee, Grand_Cherokee_L, Grand_Cherokee_4xe, Grand_Cherokee_SRT, Grand_Cherokee_WK, Cherokee, Compass). Access: free as guest - no login, no VIN (the site offers sign-in only for personalized content). jeep.com owner links lead to the same Mopar pages. Method: www.mopar.com returns Akamai 'Access Denied' (403) to non-browser HTTP clients from this network (bot protection; the site works in a normal browser from the same IP), so pages were opened in a real browser session (no captcha). Each page loads the publication list via its own XHR /moparsvc/tweddle/publications?year=..&brand=Jeep&model=..&language=en&market=us (direct calls outside the page flow return an empty body) and caches it in sessionStorage 'OwnerStore'; documents were taken from that list (fields itemtype/title/payload; all entries market=US, language=en). Files are hosted on vehicleinfo.mopar.com/assets/publications/en-us/Jeep/... (2026: /en-us-ca/2026/...), and maintenance schedules (itemtype MAINT) are JSON data files on mopardocs.azureedge.net (2017-2023) or vehicleinfo.mopar.com (2024+), which the site's maintenance-schedule page renders; they are included as doc_type maintenance_guide with format json. Verification 2026-10-02: GET Range bytes=0-1023 - PDFs: HTTP 206 + %PDF; JSON: HTTP 206 + body starting with '{' or '['. vehicleinfo.mopar.com answers scripted requests normally; mopardocs.azureedge.net was checked with curl (Python TLS handshake to that Azure Front Door host failed). US edition: US market list; file names use EN_USC / EN_US (US/Canada English and US-only English); 2026 files sit under an en-us-ca path (joint US/Canada English edition). Line notes: grand-cherokee includes all Mopar sub-entries. 2022-2024 'Grand_Cherokee' pages serve the Grand Cherokee L/WL publication set (one shared WL owner manual for Grand Cherokee and Grand Cherokee L); 2022 additionally has the carry-over WK2 'Grand_Cherokee_WK' manual; 4xe has its own page and Hybrid Supplement; titles carry the Mopar variant. SRT: 2014 SRT owner manual is listed on the Grand_Cherokee 2014 page; 2015-2019 under Grand_Cherokee_SRT. BROKEN LINK: the 2015 'SRT Owner Manual' that Mopar lists on the 2015 Grand_Cherokee_SRT page points to .../en-us/Jeep/2015/Grand_Cherokee/242.pdf, which returns HTTP 404 (kept with verified=false; no alternative URL was guessed). Trackhawk has no separate Mopar entry; for 2020-2021 no separate SRT/Trackhawk manual is listed (2021 Grand Cherokee page lists an 'SRT/Performance Features Guide Supplement'). Compass 2017: only the new-generation (MP) 2017 Compass owner manual is listed; the previous-generation (MK) 2017 Compass manual is not on Mopar. Compass 2014-2016 and Cherokee 2014-2016 have no separate maintenance item (schedule is inside the owner manual). doc_type mapping: OM->owners_manual; MAINT->maintenance_guide; WT (vehicle warranty booklets: gas/diesel/hybrid/4xe)->warranty_maintenance; QRG/QSG->quick_reference; User Guide, Owner Handbook, California emissions warranty, Hybrid/Diesel/Drive-mode/SRT/Laredo supplements, tire warranty->other. Excluded items present in the lists: Uconnect radio manuals and tips cards, HotSpot, videos, Mopar parts warranties, roadside assistance, tire chain chart, lemon-law/consumer-information sheets, the generic California Song-Beverly addendum, and the online-HTML owner manual data feed (toc.json).
